title: FunApps — Free Canadian Browser Games & Little Escapes
description: A little Canadian arcade: Maritime food games, curious adventures, clickers, puzzles and creative escapes. Pick something and play.

games.name: Last Boat
games.description: The horn already went at Western Brook Pond. Run the boardwalk, jump the rocks, duck the spruce, and reach the dock before the tour boat slips into the fjord.
controls: Space, or the right side of the screen, jumps.
Down arrow, S, or the left side ducks under spruce.
P pauses. Make the dock before the clock runs out.

games.name: Bring 'Em In
games.description: A morning out of Shelburne, Nova Scotia. Steer to your red buoys, haul the pots, and tie up at Government Wharf before the bell.
controls: A or Left turns the boat left. D or Right turns it right.
W or Ahead goes forward. Slow down beside a red buoy, then haul.
Tie up at the wharf before the bell. Blue buoys are not yours.

games.name: Westward: Mountain Run
games.description: Jump into a mountain run. Hop over rocks, collect postcards, and watch Banff-inspired peaks give way to Jasper.
controls: Press or tap to jump immediately; the hiker runs automatically.
Collect postcards and clear the rocks in a short mountain run.
Pause when needed, then replay after the run.

games.name: Prairie Windrider
games.description: Catch the prairie breeze in a land yacht. Steer through a moving landscape, collect mail, and dodge the obstacles.
controls: Steer with the pointer, touch controls, or left and right keys.
Collect postcards and avoid obstacles while the wind nudges your yacht.
Finish the short mail run and try to beat your score.

games.name: North of the Harbour: Supply Run
games.description: Take a sled across the northern ice. Steer for supply crates, dodge dark ice, and bring home a better score.
controls: Move left or right with the pointer, touch controls, or arrow keys.
Collect supply crates and avoid dark ice.
Pause or replay the short sled run.

games.name: Bonjour, voisin! — Québec
games.description: You’re an anglophone visiting a Québec restaurant. Order the food you want in French, with picture cues and friendly English help.
controls: Look at what you want, then tap a French phrase or press 1, 2 or 3.
Ask for English help whenever you need it; the server helps you learn.
Order your way through a short restaurant visit, from coffee to the bill.

games.name: Signal Hill: 1901
games.description: Fly Marconi’s kite antenna into the golden signal. Hold close to the centre for more points as you receive three dots across the Atlantic.
controls: Move the pointer, drag, or use arrow keys to steer the kite.
Stay close to the signal’s centre for more precision points while receiving three dots: Morse S.
Catch the signal before the 40-second round ends, then replay to improve your score.

games.name: Niagara: Current Keeper
games.description: The water is already flowing. Slide the gate to guide Niagara’s current into the glowing basin and fill each stage.
controls: Drag the gate or use left and right controls.
Guide the falling water into the glowing target.
Fill three basins and replay for a better score.

games.name: Fundy Tidekeeper
games.description: Ride the moving Fundy tide. Steer your boat toward floating supplies and clear the rocks as the water rises and falls.
controls: Steer the boat left and right with the pointer, touch or keyboard.
Collect floating supplies and avoid exposed rocks.
Play a short tide run, pause, or try again.

games.name: Cabot Trail: Postcard Cruise
games.description: The car is rolling and Cape Breton’s curves are ahead. Steer through the scenery and collect photo pickups along the road.
controls: Steer with left and right keys, the pointer, or on-screen controls.
The car accelerates automatically; brake when needed.
Collect photo pickups and complete the scenic drive.

games.name: Hemmed In: Confederation Bridge
games.description: Twelve point nine kilometres, one lane each way, and concrete tall enough to edit out the ocean. Weave past trucks, fight the Strait's wind, and sit up to sneak a look over the wall — if you can still steer.
controls: Steer with A and D, the arrow keys, Left/Right buttons, or by dragging the road.
Hold Space or Sit up to peek over the wall; every second of real ocean scores, double on the hump. Steering goes soft while you gawk.
The car cruises. Ease off with S, the down arrow, or the brake when a trailer fills the lane. A full case of white knuckles ends the crossing early.

games.name: Kouchibouguac: Trail Ride
games.description: Hop on and start pedalling. Steer through a moving park-inspired trail, collect camera pickups, and dodge the fallen logs.
controls: The bike pedals automatically. Steer left and right with keys, pointer or touch.
Collect camera pickups and dodge logs.
Finish the 50-second trail ride and replay for a higher score.

games.name: PEI Potato Harvest
games.description: Potatoes are popping out of PEI’s red soil. Pick the ripe ones, leave the rocks, and fill your basket before the shift ends.
controls: Tap the potatoes as they pop out of the soil.
Leave the rocks and build a harvest streak.
Finish the short picking round and try again.

games.name: Newfoundland Ferry
games.description: Cars are arriving and the ferry is getting ready to sail. Match each vehicle to its pictured lane and get everyone aboard.
controls: Tap the matching lane or use keys 1, 2 and 3.
Load the arriving vehicles using the picture cues.
Complete the loading rush and watch the ferry sail.

games.name: Jellybean Row
games.description: The fog is rolling into St. John's. Paint each Jellybean Row house the colour on its jellybean so the boats can still find home.
controls: Tap a paint colour, then tap the house with the matching jellybean.
Keys 1–6 pick a colour. Q W E R T paint the five houses from left to right.
Clear a row to earn a few more seconds. The shift ends when the fog wins.

games.name: Postcards from Canada
games.description: One van, ten views, two oceans. Snap moving landmarks as they enter your camera frame on a quick cross-Canada trip.
controls: Tap SNAP or press Space as a landmark enters the glowing camera frame.
The van drives automatically; collect up to ten postcards in 48 seconds.
Pause with P or Escape and replay to improve your score.

games.name: Donair Dash
games.description: A quick shift at the donair counter. Catch the right toppings in order, dodge the extras, and see how many donairs you can serve in 60 seconds.
controls: Follow the order and catch its toppings in sequence.
Dodge unwanted extras and serve before the 60-second shift ends.

games.name: Clams & Chips: Fryday Rush
games.description: Deep-fried Maritime clam meat and thick-cut chips, fresh from your fry shack. Work two fryers and get the timing right during a 90-second rush.
controls: Manage the clam fryer and chip fryer separately.
Time each batch and serve the orders during the 90-second rush.

games.name: Shell Shocked: Harbourfront Lobster Rush
games.description: A steaming lobster dinner on the Halifax waterfront, against the clock. Crack the shell, pick out the stuck meat, dunk it in butter, and shoo the gulls before they steal a bite.
controls: Tap a claw, knuckle or the tail again and again to crack it open.
Tap the meat to dunk it in butter and eat it. Quick bites build a combo.
Tap swooping gulls to shoo them. Each finished lobster adds 7 seconds.

games.name: Some Steep! A Maritimer Skis Banff
games.description: A Nova Scotian who learned to ski on a Maritime bump takes on a real Rocky Mountain run. Weave past pines, elk and selfie-takers, hit bumps for air, and grab Timbits and the odd donair on the way down.
controls: Drag, move the mouse, or use the left and right arrow keys to steer.
Dodge trees, rocks, elk and tourists. Hit the bumps to jump over trouble.
Grab Timbits and donairs, ski through gates for combos. Three wipeouts and you're done.

games.name: Wildlife Jam! A Maritimer Drives Banff
games.description: A Nova Scotian in a rusty hatchback with a canoe on the roof meets a Rocky Mountain wildlife jam. Dodge brake-slammers, people wandering out of their cars for photos, RVs, oncoming traffic, elk, bears and bighorn sheep.
controls: Drag, move the mouse, or use the left and right arrow keys to steer.
Hold BRAKE (or the down arrow or space) when cars stop dead or people step into the road.
Pass animals slowly for a photo bonus. Grab Timbits and double-doubles. Three crashes and you're towed.

games.name: Kitchen Party: Outta Hand!
games.description: The kitchen party has taken on a life of its own. Serve snacks, collect fiddle notes, and dodge hazards across four ways to play.

games.name: Sou’wester Survival
games.description: A very Maritime forecast: donairs, bottles, and fiddles coming your way. Catch the good stuff while steering clear of geese and snowballs.

games.name: True North Turbo
games.description: A rapid-fire gauntlet of Canadian microgames. Read the next challenge, react quickly, and keep the run going.

games.name: Kitchen Party: Coast-to-Coast Chaos
games.description: The guests are getting impatient. Carry supplies through a lively kitchen party, avoid hazards, and keep everyone looked after.

games.name: One More Tune!
games.description: There is always room for one more tune. Match guests to their stations, tap along to the beat, and keep the party moving.

games.name: Double-Double Empire
games.description: Start with coffee and think bigger. Build income, buy upgrades, and collect achievements as your double-double business grows.

games.name: SOME GOOD! — The Great Maritime Gauntlet
games.description: Eight fast East Coast challenges, three mittens, and no time to dawdle. See how long you can hang on through the gauntlet.

games.name: Some Good Kitchen Party
games.description: Step into a 3D kitchen party, keep the guests fed, and find the fiddle tunes that keep the good times going.

games.name: The Trans-Canada Trek
games.description: Set out from St. John’s for Vancouver. Balance fuel, money, car health, and morale on a road trip across Canada.

games.name: Keep ’Er Goin’!
games.description: The kettle, the food, the music—somebody has to keep track of it all. Deal with party emergencies and keep this gathering going.

games.name: YES B’Y! — The Great East Coast Clicker
games.description: Haul traps, earn your next upgrade, and build an Atlantic business one click at a time.

games.name: Out for a Rip
games.description: Head out on an Atlantic delivery run. Get the errands done while the weather does its best to complicate your day.

games.name: Maritime Merchant: The Cabot Trail
games.description: Trade between ports and put your earnings into a better vessel. Make your way through a Maritime merchant’s life.

games.name: Kitchen Party Tycoon
games.description: Turn a kitchen party into a growing operation. Earn Sociables, spend them on upgrades, and keep the gathering getting bigger.

games.name: Some Good Game — East Coast Mayhem
games.description: Take on rapid-fire tasks as the timers shrink. You have three lobster lives to see you through the East Coast mayhem.

games.name: Fog Over Fundy
games.description: Pilot a boat through the fog, use signal flares, and make upgrades while keeping an eye out for the creatures in the mist.
